items.text: Seven Card Stud Hi-Lo Eight or Better: High-low split pot with an 8-or-better qualifier for low using ace-to-five lowball ranking; if no qualifying low hand, the high hand wins the entire pot.

Seven Card Stud High-Low with Declare: After the final betting round, players simultaneously declare high, low, or both (for example using chips in hand); only declared directions may win their half of the pot, and a both-declaring player must win both high and low to scoop.
